claim: Ministerial Decision 2249 of 2025 issued by the Interior Minister sets the executive regulations of the foreigners' residence decree-law; 41 articles, in force one month after publication
quote: القرار الوزاري رقم 2249 لسنة 2025 بشأن اللائحة التنفيذية لمرسوم قانون إقامة الأجانب، مكونة من 41 مادة
note: Al-Jarida prints the regulation text; official gazette copy not obtained (blocked)

claim: A private-sector work entry visa is issued on the basis of a work permit from the competent government body
quote: سمة دخول للعمل في القطاع الأهلي، وتصدر بناء على تصريح عمل صادر من الجهة الحكومية المختصة

claim: A foreigner entering on a residence entry visa may stay up to two months from entry and must complete temporary or ordinary residence procedures within that time
quote: البقاء فيها لمدة لا تزيد على شهرين من تاريخ دخوله لها، ويتعين عليه خلال تلك المدة استكمال إجراءات الحصول على الإقامة المؤقتة أو العادية

claim: For ordinary residence the passport must be valid for at least six months when applying, and residence length is no longer tied to passport validity
quote: صالحا لمدة لا تقل عن ستة أشهر عند طلب الحصول على الإقامة، ولا ترتبط مدة الإقامة العادية بمدة صلاحية جواز السفر

claim: Ordinary residence ends when its purpose ends, even before its expiry
quote: وترتبط مدة الإقامة العادية بالغرض منها، وتنتهي بانتهاء هذا الغرض ولو قبل نهاية مدتها

claim: Ordinary residence may be granted for up to five years
quote: يجوز الترخيص بالإقامة العادية للأجانب لمدة لا تجاوز خمس سنوات

claim: Getting, renewing or transferring residence requires proof of registration in MOH health insurance (government scheme or MOH-approved insurance) in the worker's name, and residence is granted no longer than the insurance period
quote: إثبات التسجيل في نظام الضمان الصحي أو التأمين الصحي الصادر من وزارة الصحة باسم المكفول، على أن تمنح الإقامة العادية لمدة لا تزيد على مدة الضمان الصحي

claim: A worker who entered on a work entry visa, started the residence formalities, had to leave and stayed out no more than a month can have the visit converted (Article 16 case 4)
quote: لمن دخل الكويت بموجب سمة دخول للعمل وباشر إجراءات الحصول على مستلزمات منح الإقامة وغادر مضطراً وبقي في الخارج مدة لا تزيد على شهر واحد

claim: Article 18: ordinary residence for private-sector work is granted under a work permit from the competent government body, and the worker's residence can be transferred only with that body's permission
quote: يجوز منح الإقامة العادية للأجنبي للعمل في القطاع الأهلي، بموجب إذن عمل صادر له من الجهات الحكومية المختصة، ولا يجوز تحويل إقامة العامل في هذا القطاع إلا بتصريح من الجهة الحكومية المختصة

claim: Everyone coming for ordinary residence from a country with a Kuwaiti embassy must present a criminal record certificate to that embassy for attestation
quote: تقديم صحيفة حالة جنائية إلى هذه السفارات والقنصليات لاعتمادها

claim: A first ordinary residence requires fingerprints from the General Department of Criminal Evidence and an MOH health certificate showing no communicable disease
quote: أن تكون لديه بصمة صادرة عن الإدارة العامة للأدلة الجنائية، وتوفير شهادة صحية صادرة من وزارة الصحة العامة تفيد خلوه من الأمراض السارية

claim: When a private-sector worker's residence ends or renewal is refused, residency affairs may give a departure notice of up to three months, extendable once, up to six months from the end of service
quote: إشعار مغادرة دولة الكويت لمدة لا تجاوز ثلاثة أشهر قابلة للتمديد لمدة واحدة مماثلة وبما لا يجاوز ستة أشهر من تاريخ انتهاء خدمته

claim: Ordinary residence details are recorded on the Civil ID card issued by PACI
quote: تثبت بيانات الإقامة العادية للأجانب بالبطاقة المدنية الصادرة عن الهيئة العامة للمعلومات المدنية

claim: A former resident who worked as a driver or mandoub (company representative) cannot get a new work entry visa in either job until two years after leaving
quote: لا يسمح بإصدار سمة دخول للعمل بمهنة سائق أو مندوب وفقا للمواد (17,18,20) من هذا القرار للأجنبي الذي كان مقيماً في دولة الكويت ويشغل إحدى هاتين المهنتين، إلا بعد مرور سنتين من تاريخ مغادرته البلاد

claim: A resident may not stay outside Kuwait more than six months (exemptions: children of Kuwaiti women, property owners, qualifying investors)
quote: لا يجوز للأجنبي المرخص له بالإقامة البقاء خارج دولة الكويت لمدة تزيد على ستة أشهر

claim: Residency affairs may give a resident permission to be away longer than six months, on its conditions, provided the residence is valid
quote: ويجوز منح الأجنبي المرخص له بالإقامة إذناً بالغياب خارج دولة الكويت لمدة تزيد على المدة المشار إليها وفق الشروط والضوابط التي تحددها الإدارة العامة لشؤون الإقامة، وبشرط أن تكون إقامته صالحة

claim: Administrative deportation even with valid residence includes working for someone other than the employer without permission
quote: إذا عمل لدى الغير بدون إذن من جهة عمله الحكومية، أو بدون إذن الجهات المختصة

claim: The regulations replaced Ministerial Decision 957 of 2019
quote: يلغى القرار الوزاري رقم 957 لسنة 2019 المشار إليه

claim: The regulations were published in Kuwait Al-Youm and took effect one month later, on 23 December 2025
quote: أي في 23 ديسمبر المقبل

claim: Entry visa for private-sector work (and the other residence entry visas) costs KD 10
quote: 10 دنانير لـ 9 أنواع من سمات الدخول للإقامة: العمل في القطاع الحكومي - العمل في القطاع الأهلي

claim: Residence for private-sector work under Article 18 costs KD 20 per year
quote: إقامة للعمل بالقطاع الأهلي وفق المادة (18) 20 د.ك عن كل سنة

claim: Departure notice (Article 34) costs KD 10 per month
quote: إشعار مغادرة وفق المادة (34) 10 د.ك عن كل شهر

claim: Permission to be absent from Kuwait costs KD 5 per month
quote: إذن غياب خارج الكويت 5 د.ك عن كل شهر

claim: Temporary residence (Article 14) costs KD 10 per month (KD 5 for domestic workers)
quote: 5 د.ك عن كل شهر لفئة العمالة المنزلية 10 د.ك عن كل شهر لباقي الفئات

claim: From 23 December 2025 the annual iqama fee for government and private-sector workers doubled to KD 20
quote: The annual renewal fee for most types of residency has been doubled to KD 20. This applies to expatriates working in the government and private sectors

claim: Ordinary residency is valid for up to five years for most expatriates
quote: Ordinary residency is valid for up to five years for most expatriates

claim: From 23 December 2025 the government health insurance fee for expatriates in government and private sectors is KD 100 a year (KD 10 for agricultural workers, fishermen, shepherds and dairy workers)
quote: The government’s health insurance is KD 100 for expats working in the government and private sectors except agricultural workers, fishermen, shepherds and workers in dairy companies, who will pay only KD 10

claim: Before this, the government health insurance had been KD 50 for workers
quote: the government’s health insurance has been KD 50 for workers

claim: Expats arriving on entry visas to take up residence pay a KD 5 monthly health insurance fee
quote: It imposes a monthly fee of KD 5 for expats who arrive on entry visas seeking permanent residency in the country

claim: No residence is issued or renewed without health insurance; the amount must be paid by the Kuwaiti sponsor or the visitor
quote: The amount must be paid by the Kuwaiti sponsor or the visitor.

claim: No residence or visit visa is issued or renewed without one of the three types of health insurance
quote: no residence or visit visa will be issued or renewed without obtaining any of the three types of health insurance

claim: Since MOI Decision 1091 of 2026 (2026), converting a visit visa into regular residence costs KD 150; domestic workers are exempt
quote: Kuwait has introduced a KD150 fee for converting visit visas into regular residency permits

claim: PAM's board imposed an additional KD 150 fee for issuing a first-time work permit, from 1 June 2024
quote: The new decision imposes an additional fee of KD 150 for issuing a work permit for the first time.

claim: From 1 June 2024 employers may recruit from abroad as estimated for their licence, replacing the 25% overseas quota
quote: Employers can now bring in migrant workers from abroad as estimated for their license, instead of the previously set quota of 25 percent for overseas recruitment

claim: PAM says failing to assign workers the tasks in their work permit can bring up to 3 years' jail and KD 2,000-10,000 fines per worker
quote: failure to assign tasks as per the work permit could lead to penalties, including imprisonment for up to 3 years and fines ranging between 2,000 and 10,000 dinars per worker, or both

claim: A KD 150 fee is charged for issuing a first-time work permit, and KD 300 to transfer a worker to another company in the first three years with the employer's approval
quote: a fee of 150 dinars will be charged for issuing a first-time work permit

claim: In November 2024 the Interior Minister cancelled Article 1 of PAM decision 294/2023, which made workers aged 60+ with high-school education or less pay KD 250 a year plus irrevocable comprehensive health insurance to renew work permits
quote: requiring them to pay an additional annual fee of 250 Kuwaiti dinars and obtain an irrevocable comprehensive health insurance policy to renew their work permits

claim: Workers aged 60+ without a university degree can again renew or transfer work permits without the extra fees, which had totalled up to KD 900
quote: allowing workers aged 60 and above with non-university degrees to renew their work permits or transfer them to another employer without the need to pay fees that could total up to KD 900

claim: PAM announced on 4 December 2024 that all restrictions on expats over 60 were scrapped and they pay regular fees
quote: all restrictions imposed on expats aged over 60 years have been scrapped and they will now pay regular fees to obtain work permits and renew their residencies

claim: About four years before (2020-21) the government banned renewal for expats over 60 without a degree, forcing many to leave
quote: About four years ago, the government slapped a total ban on the renewal of residency for expats over 60 without a degree, and as a result, many such expats were forced to leave the country for good.

claim: In July 2021 newspapers reported PAM would let over-60s without a degree renew for KD 2,000 a year
quote: allow expats over 60 years of age without a degree to renew their work permits and residencies against a payment of KD 2,000 annually

claim: Under MD 2249/2025 any resident may not stay outside Kuwait more than six consecutive months; it applies to all residency categories unless exempted
quote: any expats authorised to reside in Kuwait is not permitted to stay outside the country for more than six consecutive months

claim: Domestic workers' leave-of-absence requests can be made at residency affairs departments or electronically through the Sahel app
quote: Such requests can be made either by visiting the relevant Residency Affairs Departments or by applying electronically through the Sahel application.

claim: KSE's authority over engineer exams has been withdrawn; PAM and the Ministry of Higher Education handle degree verification, equivalency and professional classification
quote: the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) and the Ministry of Higher Education (MoHE) have taken over responsibility for degree verification, equivalency, and professional classification

claim: The engineering degree must be attested by the university, the Ministry of Higher Education and MOFA of the country of study, and finally by the Kuwait Embassy
quote: Finally attested by the Kuwait Embassy or Consulate

claim: In Kuwait the attested degree must be stamped by Kuwait's Ministry of Foreign Affairs
quote: Once in Kuwait, the attested degree certificate must be stamped by the Kuwait Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) to confirm its authenticity.

claim: PAM's classification under an engineering job title is needed to issue the work permit and to put the profession on the Civil ID
quote: Assigning the correct profession on the Civil ID

claim: The process is documentation-based and no KSE exam is required
quote: At present, this process is documentation-based, and no KSE-conducted exam is required.

claim: Some employers may still ask for KSE membership, which is not a substitute for government recognition
quote: some employers may still request KSE membership for internal or professional purposes

claim: A 2025 PAM circular: qualification is checked by level, field and recognition status (based on MOHE equivalency) when work permits are issued, renewed or amended through Ashal or Sahel Business
quote: status of the qualification like unrecognized, preliminary recognition, administrative recognition or accreditation based on the Ministry of Higher Education equivalency

claim: PAM staff verify that the field of specialisation matches the profession in the application
quote: verifying the compatibility between the field of specialization and profession specified in the application

claim: For engineering professions, approvals are checked automatically and applications without them are rejected
quote: For engineering professions, approvals are verified automatically through the system. Applications that do not have the required approval are automatically rejected.

claim: Renewing a work permit for the same profession needs no qualification attachment
quote: provided the renewal is for the same profession. These services do not require attachment of approvals or academic qualifications to the application

claim: Under MD 270/2020 a non-Kuwaiti needs more than two years' legal residence, a university degree and a salary of at least KD 600 a month for a private driving licence
quote: The applicants must have a private or general driving license as well as a legal residency in Kuwait for more than two years. The applicants should be a university degree graduate, and must be earning a monthly salary of no less than six hundred Kuwaiti dinars.

quote: Domestic workers who worked for a minimum period of two consecutive years with the same sponsor and changed their residence title to driver profession.

claim: Also exempt: oil-sector technicians and specialists, and medical technicians
